phrases.text: Well, let me think about it for a second.

translations.en: Well, let me think about it for a second.

phrases.text: To be honest, I don't really know.

translations.es: Para ser honesto, realmente no lo sé.
translations.en: To be honest, I don't really know.

phrases.text: By the way, did you see that new movie?

translations.en: By the way, did you see that new movie?

phrases.text: You know what I mean, right?

translations.es: Sabes a lo que me refiero, ¿verdad?
translations.en: You know what I mean, right?

phrases.text: I mean, it's not a bad idea actually.

translations.es: O sea, en realidad no es una mala idea.
translations.en: I mean, it's not a bad idea actually.

phrases.text: Basically, we just need to wait here.

translations.en: Basically, we just need to wait here.

phrases.text: At the end of the day, it's your choice.

translations.es: Al final del día, es tu decisión.
translations.en: At the end of the day, it's your choice.
